correctness.rationale: For a≥3, exact invariant decomposition gives antisymmetric mode −t/(b+t), a+b−4 zero modes and stochastic 3×3 quotient; Vieta gives the two remaining nonunit modes and displayed Δ, while a=2 has a separately checked 2×2 quotient. Rescaling x=t/b yields derivative numerator (8a²−12a−2)x²+8a(a−2)x−3a, with unique positive root since leading/linear positive and constant negative. Monotonicity ∂Δ/∂a=x(2x+3)/(2(a+x)²)>0 reduces the universal lower bound to a=2, where (1+2x)(2+x)−9x=2(x−1)² proves sharp −1/6 equality x=1. Balanced n asymptotics follow by direct substitution. Independent exact rational inverse-fundamental-matrix calculations compared K to the formula on 80 parameter/strength combinations. Periodicity of unweighted bipartite chain is no problem for Kemeny eigenvalue formula with nonunit λ including −1.
